"This [the limitations of NLP models] was revealed when a researcher at Georgetown University, Douglas Hofstadter, tested a neural network by having it read a short story called 'A Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy.' This example, along with others, demonstrated that although NLP (natural-language processing) models are capable of incredible feats, their abilities are very much limited by the amount of context they receive.
